alerts.reason: Tyson’s reported sales growth slowed from 16.08% to 8.15% year over year. If that 7.93-point slowdown repeats each quarter, growth would be about 0.2% in the intervening quarter and −7.7% in the target quarter. Lower volume reduced sales by $223 million, partly because higher prices weighed on demand (A). Continued price increases are the main uncertainty in that projection (D).
